rules: Use {name} placeholders. Never concatenate sentence fragments — word order differs across languages.
Missing keys render as the key itself, so gaps are visible rather than silently blank.

app.name: Special Coffee Wiki
loading.title: Loading
error.dataFailed: Could not load the data files
error.fileProtocol: This page does not work when opened directly via file://. Browser security prevents reading local JSON that way.
error.howToRun: Run one of these in the project folder, then open http://localhost:8000
onboard.q1.title: Which dripper do you use?
onboard.q1.sub: Recipes will be converted for this brewer. You can change it anytime.
onboard.q2.title: And your grinder?
onboard.q2.sub: Needed so grind settings can be shown in your own clicks rather than someone else's.
onboard.q3.title: What is your usual V60 setting?
onboard.q3.sub: This becomes your anchor (band 0). Every recipe is then shown as so many steps coarser or finer from here.
onboard.q3.why.title: Why does this matter?
onboard.q3.why.body: Burr shape and size differ between grinders, so the same micron figure does not mean the same particle distribution. Instead of absolute numbers we show offsets from your own anchor. That way any grinder works, even one that is not in our catalogue.
onboard.q3.preview: With this anchor, recipes will read like this
onboard.q3.unsure: Not sure? Leave the default. You can adjust it later once you have some logs.
onboard.done.title: You're set
onboard.done.sub: These settings are stored in this browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: This clears your gear setup and starts over. Continue?
settings.storageNote: Settings and brew logs live only in this browser. Clearing browser data removes them, so export a backup.
home.title: What are we brewing?
home.phase: Phase 1 complete — recommendations, brew guide and logging all work.
home.next: Up next: championship recipe archive (2), flavor explorer (3)
rec.title: What are you brewing?
rec.flavorHint: Pick from the cupping notes on the bag. Multiple choices allowed.
rec.goalHint: What do you want to bring out in this cup?
rec.mismatchNote: These differ substantially in roast level or flavor and are not recommended. The score is a relative ranking value only.
rec.startSoon: The brew guide arrives in Phase 1c
why.brewerExact: Exact dripper match — no conversion needed
why.brewerCompatible: Listed by this recipe as a compatible brewer
why.brewerSimilar: Different dripper, so parameters were adjusted
why.brewerDifferent: Quite a different brewer, so the adjustments are large
why.roastFar: Far from the roast level this recipe targets
why.goalMiss: This recipe leans a different direction
conv.flowFaster: Your dripper drains faster ({from} → {to}), shortening contact time
conv.flowSlower: Your dripper drains slower ({from} → {to}), lengthening contact time
conv.flowSlowerTemp: Temperature lowered to offset the longer contact time
conv.roastTemp: Set to the recommended band for {roast} roasts ({lo}–{hi} °C)
conv.roastGrind: Grind shifted to the {roast} roast baseline
conv.preheat: This brewer must be preheated. Skipping it drops the real brew temperature by 3–5 °C
conv.freshBloom: Only {days} days off roast, so there is a lot of CO2. Give the bloom about 10 more seconds
conv.staleTemp: {days} days off roast extracts less readily, so the temperature was raised
conv.lowTdsOk: The original uses {ppm} ppm low-mineral water. Filtered water is a fair approximation
conv.grindClamped: This hits the end of your grinder's usable range
brew.prep.title: Prepare
brew.prep.armNote: Starting enables sound and vibration, so you can follow the steps without watching the screen.
brew.prep.noSteps: This recipe has no step data
brew.exitConfirm: Stop brewing and leave? The running timer will be lost.
brew.keepOnFail: This browser does not support keeping the screen on
brew.done.title: Brew complete
tas.title: How was it?
tas.sub: Just three fields. The rest can come later.
tas.flavorHint: Pick what you actually tasted, not what the bag says.
tas.nextHint: This line appears at the top of your next brew screen.
tas.nextPh: e.g. Drop temp 1 °C and cut the 3rd pour by 20 g
tas.quotaFull: Browser storage is full. Export your logs, then delete older entries.
log.title: Brew log
log.emptySub: They appear here once you finish a brew.
log.importFailed: This file is not a brew log export
log.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.
log.backupNote: Logs live only in this browser. Clearing browser data removes them, so export a backup now and then.
